name: Precinct Three
source:
Follow the group from Precinct Three as they try to solve the mystery behind a dead body, getting wrapped up in more than they bargained for.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
跟隨第三分局的一夥人調查一具屍體背後的謎團。他們越查越深，惹上的事遠遠超出了預料。

［取自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
